shots.name: lens-correction-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Lens Correction card: the Preset menu showing Action Cam, the Lens menu on Manual, the Geometry section with Framing on Original size, Distortion −28, Fine Distortion 0, Scale 120 and Center X and Y 0.5, the folded Chromatic aberration section and the Vignette section with its switch, Amount and Midpoint, beside a strip of the preview with the straightened night street
shots.caption: Lens Correction with the Action Cam preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Lens: a measured lens or Manual. 3 — Framing: keep the size or show the whole photo. 4 — Distortion: straightens bowed lines. 5 — Scale: zooms in or out.

shots.name: guided-perspective-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Guided Perspective card: the Preset menu showing Fill Frame, the Perspective section with the Guides row and its Edit guides and Reset buttons, a note that two vertical guides are applied, the Framing menu on Fill frame, Strength 100 % and Scale 100 %, beside a strip of the preview with the straightened night street
shots.caption: Guided Perspective with two guides and the Fill Frame preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Guides: draw the lines in the Preview. 3 — Framing: whole photo or fill the frame. 4 — Strength: how much of the lean is removed. 5 — Scale: zooms in or out.

shots.name: ai-edge-fill-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with an AI Edge Fill card: the Preset row, the Generate section with Resolution on 2K, the Scene menu on Room, the Scene text field with this room, walls, ceiling and floor, the Generate fill button and a note that Nano Banana Pro on Kie.ai receives the corrected photo and a mask of its empty edges, then the Blend section with Fill Opacity 100 % and Seam Blend 12 px
shots.caption: AI Edge Fill before its first fill. 1 — Resolution: the size of the generated picture. 2 — Scene: what the empty edges should continue. 3 — Fill: sends the request. 4 — Fill Opacity: how strongly the fill shows. 5 — Seam Blend: matches its colour to the photo.

shots.name: twirl-inspector
shots.alt: The Twirl effect card in Properties → Effects: Twist 200°, Radius 0.6, Center X and Center Y 0.5, Shape Circle and Frame Edges Mirror

shots.name: fisheye-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Fisheye Lens card on the Crystal Ball preset: the Lens section with Projection Stereographic, Strength 1, Field of View 160° and Curve Bias 0, the Framing section with Lens Radius 0.9, Zoom, Center X and Y, Squeeze, Lens Rotation and Round Lens, the Edges section with Lens Feather 0.04, and the Optics and Quality sections below, beside a strip of the preview with the walker inside a round glass ball
shots.caption: Fisheye Lens with the Crystal Ball preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Projection: the lens model. 3 — Field of View: how wide the lens sees. 4 — Lens Radius: the size of the lens circle. 5 — Lens Feather: softens the rim of the circle.

shots.name: bulge-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Bulge & Pinch card on the Magnifying Glass preset: the Preset menu, Amount 3, Radius 0.3, Center X and Y 0.5, Shape Circle and Frame Edges Mirror, beside a strip of the preview with the walker enlarged under a small round glass
shots.caption: Bulge & Pinch with the Magnifying Glass preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Amount: bulge above 1, pinch below. 3 — Radius: the size of the area. 4 — Shape: round or stretched with the frame. 5 — Frame Edges: what shows beyond the picture.
